description: This file contains unit tests for the DID Handlers in a Go project, testing various API endpoints such as DID registration, verification, resolution, workflow VC creation, export, and execution VC creation. It uses the Gin web framework and testify for assertions, with mocked services for DID and VC operations.

methods.name: TestRegisterAgentHandler_Success
methods.description: Tests the successful registration of a DID agent via the register endpoint.

methods.name: TestVerifyVCHandler_Success
methods.description: Tests successful verification of a VC through the verify endpoint.

methods.name: TestResolveDIDHandler
methods.description: Tests resolution of a DID to its details.

methods.name: TestGetWorkflowVCChainHandler
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the VC chain for a workflow.

methods.name: TestCreateWorkflowVCHandler
methods.description: Tests creation of a workflow VC.

methods.name: TestExportVCsHandler
methods.description: Tests exporting of VCs and retrieval of multiple VC records.

methods.name: TestGetDIDStatusHandler
methods.description: Tests fetching the status of the DID service.

methods.name: TestGetDIDDocumentHandler
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a DID document by its identifier.

methods.name: TestCreateExecutionVC_ReturnsVCInfo
methods.description: Tests creation of an execution VC with the returned VC info.
